subject: Trading
title: Pips and Lots
description: A fast breakdown of Pips and Lots for builders.

hook.text: A pip is the smallest standard move in forex—the fourth decimal place. In EUR/USD, 1.1050 to 1.1051 is one pip.

buildup.text: Pip value depends on lot size. A standard lot is 100,000 units. One pip on EUR/USD then equals $10.

discovery.text: Mini lots are 10,000 units ($1 per pip), micro lots are 1,000 units ($0.10 per pip)—scaling risk to account size.

twist.text: Yen pairs are different: the pip is the second decimal. USD/JPY moving from 150.50 to 150.51 is one pip.

climax.text: Understanding pip value instantly tells you how much money each price move costs or earns you.

punchline.text: Tiny moves matter when lot sizes are large.

quiz.question: How much is one pip worth on a standard lot of EUR/USD?
